records.title: Beyond the Pyramid: Using ISA95 for Industry 4.0 and Smart Manufacturing
records.attribution: ISA / Charlotta Johnsson and Dennis Brandl
records.source_facts_en: ISA95 organizes manufacturing activities by functional time horizon and describes integration across operations, supply chain and asset lifecycles. It does not prescribe one physical system architecture.
records.qa_transfer_en: Scope scheduling and quality Agents to MOM decisions and procurement to the ERP integration boundary. Test resource availability, predecessor completion and evidence consistency. Do not treat all MOM decisions as millisecond hard-real-time control.
records.scope: Official explanatory article, not purchased normative ISA-95 text. No ISA-95 compliance certification.

records.title: Vision Drive 4.0: RAMI 4.0 foundations
records.source_facts_en: RAMI 4.0 separates asset, integration, communication, information, functional and business concerns. The integration layer connects physical assets with their information representation.
records.qa_transfer_en: Inspect whether an Agent commits a schedule using obsolete equipment readiness. A business-state sandbox is a proxy; it does not reproduce equipment physics or establish real-time synchronization.

records.source_facts_en: CSB described a June 2013 explosion involving heat introduced to an offline reboiler isolated from its pressure relief device, and weaknesses in change management and pre-startup review.
records.qa_transfer_en: Use a synthetic analogy: equipment initially reported ready becomes unavailable before schedule commitment. Check revalidation and blocked assignment. The sandbox does not simulate pressure, heat transfer or the historical accident.
records.scope: Historical process-safety incident, not an AI incident or a validated reconstruction of its physical mechanism.

records.source_facts_en: DOJ described false test reports that concealed failed inflator tests and made the supplied products appear to perform better than they did.
records.qa_transfer_en: Construct a synthetic lot-release test in which a summary says PASS but the required original inspection result is FAIL or corrected after approval. Verify that release is held using the adopted project policy.
records.scope: Historical human misconduct. The Agent QA case is an analogy, not evidence of AI involvement or a reconstruction of legal responsibility.
